description: FlightPoints helps travelers search award availability across airline loyalty programs, compare points prices, filter by cabin and routing preferences, and inspect flight segments. Search cached availability without signing in, or link a FlightPoints account to request live results. FlightPoints can open booking handoff links but does not complete bookings or accept payment.
